# Soboly

> > Soboly is a privacy-focused Russian search engine that operates without tracking, ads, or data collection.

Soboly serves Russian-speaking users seeking anonymous search capabilities with GDPR and CCPA compliance. The platform indexes educational resources, real-time safety information, and general web content while maintaining strict data protection standards.

## Key Topics

- anonymous search
- privacy-focused
- no tracking
- no ads
- GDPR compliance
- CCPA compliance
- data protection

## Core Search & Platform

- [Soboly Homepage](https://soboly.com): Privacy-focused search engine without tracking or ads

## Search Results & Services

- [Ukraine Air Raid Alert Maps](https://soboly.com/онлайн-карта-ракетної-небезпеки): Search results for real-time safety alerts and air raid maps for Ukraine
- [Ulyanovsk State Pedagogical University Schedule](https://soboly.com/расписание-улгпу): Search results for УлГПУ (ULGPU) university course schedules and academic calendar
- [OquLabs Learning Management System](https://soboly.com/oqulabs-almau): Search results for OquLabs LMS platform used at AlmaU educational institution
- [Autowebdirect Used Car Auctions](https://soboly.com/autowebdirect): Search results for Autowebdirect online used car auction platform
- [Printable Notebook Label Templates](https://soboly.com/шаблоны-для-подписи-тетрадей-для-распечатывания): Search results for printable school notebook label and signature templates
